summary: Fewer false alarms, no broken Android builds, and launchpad finds your apps and keeps the tools they already use.
notes: Android apps keep building when the review prompt is added, and native iOS apps get their scheme, team and version from the project, with no questions.
If your app already uses Sentry, Plausible or its own review prompt, launchpad keeps it instead of adding a second one.
No more alarms for what you already have: a privacy policy you link to, signing on CI, an app on Google Play, a version past 1.0.
Mission Control opens fast after a break, lists accounts before the keys made in them, and asks before using a template's Apple team.
Mac apps get usage analytics too, and Later on the update window now waits a week.

beta.summary: Every card shows one clear way to do it, and new versions arrive as a proper update window.
notes: Each to-do shows the quickest way first; other ways sit under one fold, each marked as an alternative.
A card launchpad can do itself says so, with one Do it button.
New versions open a window with the release notes and Update now, Later or Skip this version.
A newer update is never hidden behind an older notice.
Buys through a test checkout: you are not charged.
